## Major = 1 or not (Linear Model or Logistic Regression)

$$X_i \in \{\text{Senate}_i, \text{Democrat}_i, \text{DW1}_i\}$$
$$\begin{cases} Y_i^\star& = 1\{ \text{Major}_i = k\} \\ \tilde{Y}_i& = 1\{\text{MajorLLM}_i= k\}\end{cases}$$

$$\begin{cases} Y_i^\star& =\beta_{0} + \beta_{1} \text{X}_{i} \\ \tilde{Y}_i&  = \beta_{0} + \beta_{1} \text{X}_{i}\end{cases}$$

For each $m$ model and $p$ prompt modification, we fit a separate model.

```{r}
data = read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "02_llm/bills_prompts_responses_10000.csv"))

major = 1

data = data %>%
  filter(
    Model=="gpt-4o", 
    PromptingStrategyID==1
    ) %>%
  select(
    Model, PromptingStrategyID, PromptingStrategyName,
    Chamber, Party, Year, Cong, Postal, State, Description, DW1, Major, MajorText, 
    MajorLLM, MajorTextLLM, ExplanationLLM) 

if (any(is.na(data)))
  warning("data contains NA")

data = data %>%
  mutate(
    Senate = as.integer(data$Chamber == "Senate"),
    Democrat = as.integer(data$Party == "Democrat"),
    Major = as.integer(data$Major == major), # as.integer(ifelse(data$Major == 1, TRUE, FALSE)) # Major = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
    MajorLLM = as.integer(data$MajorLLM == major), # MajorLLM = relevel(as.factor(Major), ref = 20),
  )

# split data into train/test set
set.seed(SEED)
train_idx = sample(x=nrow(data), size=floor(0.5 * nrow(data)))
train = data[train_idx, ]
test = data[-train_idx, ]
# head(train)
```

### Chamber

```{r}
model_human = lm(Major ~ Senate, data=test) # do we do this on the entire dataset? or just train? I think it should be test
model_llm = lm(MajorLLM ~ Senate, data=test)  # do we do this on the entire dataset? or just train? I think it should be test

train$Bias = train$Major - train$MajorLLM
betas_bias = coef(lm(Bias ~ Senate, data = bootstrap))
test$BiasPred = betas_bias[1] + betas_bias[2] * test$Senate
test$MajorLLMDebised = test$MajorLLM + test$BiasPred
model_debiased = lm(MajorLLMDebised ~ Senate, data=test) # why is this on the test?

B = 5e3
model_debiased_coef_bootstrap = matrix(nrow=B, ncol=2)

# repeat sampling 10000 times
for (b in (1:B)){
  # get bootstrap sample
  bootstrap_indices = sample(nrow(train), replace = TRUE)
  bootstrap = train[bootstrap_indices, ]
  
  # regress (f* - f_hat) on all the Vs and store coefficients
  bootstrap$Bias = bootstrap$Major - bootstrap$MajorLLM
  betas_bias = coef(lm(Bias ~ Senate, data = bootstrap))
  test$BiasPred = betas_bias[1] + betas_bias[2] * test$Senate
  test$MajorLLMDebised = test$MajorLLM + test$BiasPred
  
  # run debiased models (regress adjusted labels on Vs)
  model_debiased_coef_bootstrap[b,] = coef(lm(MajorLLMDebised ~ Senate, data=test))
}

# get the error coefficients
# beta0_bias_chamber_mean = model_bias$coefficients[1] # mean(betas_bias[,1])
# beta1_bias_chamber_mean = model_bias$coefficients[2] # mean(betas_bias[,2])
# beta0_MajorLLMDebised_chamber_mean = model_debiased$coefficients[1] # mean(betas_MajorLLMDebised[,1])
# beta1_MajorLLMDebised_chamber_mean = model_debiased$coefficients[2] # mean(betas_MajorLLMDebised[,2])

# betas_bias_ci = t(apply(betas_bias, 2, function(col){
#   quantile(col, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
# }))
```

```{r}
model_human_se_robust = sqrt(diag(vcovHC(model_human, type = "HC1")))

model_llm_se_robust = sqrt(diag(vcovHC(model_llm, type = "HC1")))

model_debised_se_boot = apply(model_debiased_coef_bootstrap, 2, sd)
names(model_debised_se_boot) = names(coef(model_debiased))
```

```{r}

model_human_t = qt(1 - 0.05/2, df = df.residual(model_human))  # t-value for the 95%-CI
model_human_ci = cbind(coef(model_human) - model_human_t * model_human_se_robust, coef(model_human) + model_human_t * model_human_se_robust)
colnames(model_human_ci) = c("2.5%", "97.5%")

model_llm_t = qt(1 - 0.05/2, df = df.residual(model_llm))  # t-value for the 95%-CI
model_llm_ci = cbind(coef(model_llm) - model_llm_t * model_llm_se_robust, coef(model_llm) + model_llm_t * model_llm_se_robust)
colnames(model_llm_ci) = c("2.5%", "97.5%")

model_debised_ci_boot = t(apply(model_debiased_coef_bootstrap, 2, function(x){
  quantile(x, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
  }))
rownames(model_debised_ci_boot) = names(coef(model_debiased))
```

```{r}
stargazer(
  model_human, model_llm, model_debiased,
  coef = list(model_human$coefficients, model_llm$coefficients, model_debiased$coefficients),
  se = list(model_human_se_robust,  model_llm_se_robust, model_debised_se_boot),
  ci.custom = list(model_human_ci, model_llm_ci, model_debised_ci_boot),
  keep.stat = c("n"),
  type = "text")
```
